title: Leaders in Array
description: Find all elements that are greater than all elements to their right.

data.text: Given an array `arr`, find all elements that are greater than all elements to their right. The rightmost element is always a leader.
Check each element against all elements to its right. O(n²) time.

data.title: Brute Force O(n²)
data.content: Check each element against all elements to its right.

data.text: Scan from right to left, tracking the maximum seen so far. Any element greater than the current right-max is a leader. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Scan from Right O(n)
data.content: Scan from right to left, tracking the maximum seen so far.

data.title: What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n²) → O(n). **Space:** O(1) extra (output list excluded). Scanning from right exploits the leader property in a single pass.

cards.title: Brute Force
cards.description: Check each against all to its right
